notes: Account overview: mid-to-large fintech (payments + reconciliation), heavy compliance needs. Global user base, peak throughput windows at month-end.
Initial interest (May): looking for hosted inference to replace in-house heuristics for support triage + document summarization.
Primary ask: sub-200ms chat latency for support agent flows, reranking for transaction retrieval (~50 qps), strict audit logging and SSO.
POC run (Jun-Jul): Redwood hosted API + sample GA model. SE built reranking prototype and live support demo integrated into their internal agent UI.
Security review: ran SOC2 questionnaire. Redwood passed most controls but security team flagged vendor-branding policy and preferability of Tier-1 public APIs.
Commercials: Redwood pricing competitive in unit cost analysis, but procurement noted higher perceived negotiation friction vs "OpenAI standard commercial terms".
Signals on loss: during final exec call (Aug 28) CTO commented: 'We should go with OpenAI for speed — easier for product teams and less procurement headaches.'
Internal champion: product lead (Sanjay Rao) moved teams in Aug; no strong replacement — friction on internal signoff increased.
Budget: Q4 freeze announced for platform initiatives; procurement elected to push any change to vendor with lowest internal friction.
Decision: selected OpenAI direct API for initial rollout; plan to revisit multi-vendor routing later but no commitment window.
Quote from buyer (email): 'OpenAI gives us a single-vendor path that our product org trusts; we can revisit a vendor like Redwood if we need private deployment later.'
Follow-ups attempted: three re-engagement emails (Sep 5, Sep 18, Oct 3) — low response. Final outreach: NRR/feedback request.
Internal Redwood notes: strong POC but lost on brand/simplicity + organizational churn; technical blockers were manageable but not decisive.
Recommended playbook items: capture short 'one-pager' on procurement friction mitigation, pre-baked OpenAI interoperability guide, and customer reference focusing on finance sector.
Next owner action: archive deal, schedule debrief with Sales Ops (AE, SE), update competitive loss reason to 'lost to openai_direct_api'.
